title: CWS Convertor complete Viewer gap matrix
scope: Complete Viewer functionality and its Project, Production, Control and Output integrations

audit.head: a2cd946d1c2eef9ea454c2feebd4770f87600576
audit.head_subject: feat: complete converter routes in one phase

summary.primary_conclusion: Functionally advanced but not demonstrably 100 percent release ready.

status_definitions.PASS: Implementation and relevant evidence are available.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Implemented, but evidence, user experience or representative-scale proof is incomplete.
status_definitions.FAIL: A hard requirement or measured threshold is not met.
status_definitions.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE: Closure requires an external reference, machine or qualification source.
status_definitions.NOT_VERIFIABLE: A claim exists but the referenced evidence is unavailable on the audited branch.
status_definitions.OUT_OF_SCOPE: Formally approved exclusion from the release scope.

synthetic_1000_node_fixture.note: Useful controller baseline, not a substitute for real HVPC acceptance.

visual_evidence.primary_gap: The runtime UI is denser and less model-dominant than the reference, and the full Qt plus native VTK window is not captured as one evidence image.

feature_groups.name: Import and exact geometry
remaining: current-head packaged matrix for every intake type

feature_groups.name: Selection and synchronization

gaps.title: No full release evidence on exact current HEAD
gaps.evidence: Final phase-4 evidence is bound to 1513ae3ad91f; audited HEAD is a2cd946d1c2eef9ea454c2feebd4770f87600576, eleven commits later.
gaps.acceptance: Every release artifact, test report and manifest identifies the same current commit.

gaps.title: Real HVPC interaction frame rate is below target
gaps.evidence: Mean 20.392 FPS; frame p95 50.661 ms.
gaps.acceptance: Mean at least 30 FPS and frame p95 at most 33 ms on the reference machine without loss of IDs, colors or Viewer functions.

gaps.title: Input response is visibly delayed
gaps.evidence: Input-to-render p95 269.676 ms and p99 783.575 ms.
gaps.acceptance: Input-to-render p95 at most 35 ms and p99 at most 50 ms.

gaps.title: Cold exact load exceeds five seconds
gaps.evidence: First persistent exact load 7.939 seconds.
gaps.acceptance: Cold exact load at most 5.0 seconds and first usable preferably at most 3.0 seconds.

gaps.title: Freeze-free interaction is not proven
gaps.evidence: One freeze above 100 ms in the representative run.
gaps.acceptance: Zero freezes above 100 ms during a real ten-minute Viewer soak.

gaps.title: Memory drift exceeds target
gaps.evidence: RSS drift 11.519 percent against a less-than-10-percent target.
gaps.acceptance: RSS drift below 10 percent with bounded actors, workers and processes.

gaps.title: Viewer visual parity is not accepted
gaps.evidence: All reference diffs remain HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED; Viewer average normalized pixel MAE is approximately 0.643.
gaps.acceptance: Every required reference pair is manually approved and no core visual or ergonomic mismatch remains.

gaps.title: Evidence capture omits the native VTK child
gaps.evidence: Qt surface screenshots do not composite the native QVTK renderer.
gaps.acceptance: A deterministic full-window capture shows Qt chrome and native VTK exactly as the user sees them, supplemented by a renderer-native capture.

gaps.title: Release CI validates an obsolete requirement count
gaps.evidence: Workflow step says Full Product Acceptance 51 of 51 while active traceability contains 317 requirements.
gaps.acceptance: CI derives the active requirement count dynamically and fails on any unapproved non-PASS item.

gaps.title: Current-head Windows package matrix is missing
gaps.evidence: One-folder, portable, installer, associations and uninstall PASS evidence belongs to an older commit.
gaps.acceptance: All package modes pass on clean Windows VMs from the exact release SHA.

gaps.title: Object-by-object Trimble parity remains external
gaps.evidence: Same-machine timing comparison exists, but current visual and behavioral parity is blocked.
gaps.acceptance: Same model, camera, viewport and actions compared object-by-object with captured, reviewed evidence.

gaps.title: True hidden-line rendering is unavailable
gaps.evidence: The persisted HIDDEN_LINE enum is explicitly rejected by the controller.
gaps.acceptance: Depth-aware hidden-line rendering works for representative models and passes selection, section and performance regressions.

gaps.title: BCF export is not schema-certified
gaps.evidence: The implementation explicitly returns CWS-BCF-EXPORT-NOT-CERTIFIED and directs users to .cwsreview.
gaps.acceptance: A validated BCF 2.x package is emitted or BCF is formally approved as out of scope.

gaps.title: Viewer layout is too dense
gaps.evidence: Runtime captures show competing panels and grids with less model area than the references.
gaps.acceptance: The model is visually dominant by default, secondary panels are contextual and human UX review passes.

gaps.title: Referenced ten-minute soak evidence is unavailable
gaps.evidence: Traceability marks F1-009 PASS but its referenced REAL_10MIN_SOAK.json is not present in the audited branch.
gaps.acceptance: A fresh real OpenGL ten-minute soak report is committed and bound to the release SHA.

gaps.title: Product authority and version identities drift
gaps.evidence: Application 0.10.18-beta-dev, Viewer package 1.0.0-dev0 and preview contract 1.4.0-v15-preview.2 coexist; authority docs are in progress or outdated.
gaps.acceptance: One manifest generates consistent product, Viewer, schema, authority and evidence versions.

gaps.title: Canonical branch governance is unresolved
gaps.evidence: Default main is a stale placeholder and current authority work has no discovered open release PR.
gaps.acceptance: One reviewed canonical release PR lands on the designated release branch and stale PRs are closed or labelled historical.

gaps.title: Light contract tests depend on native CAD and render imports
gaps.evidence: Local discovery is blocked without CadQuery and VTK because package imports are eager.
gaps.acceptance: Pure contracts, state and controller logic are importable and testable without native CAD/render dependencies.

gaps.title: Multi-hardware Viewer qualification is incomplete
gaps.evidence: No current-head matrix covers both integrated and discrete GPU classes and multiple display resolutions.
gaps.acceptance: Reference tests pass on at least one iGPU, one mid-range dGPU, 1080p and 4K.

gaps.title: Accessibility and keyboard-depth proof is incomplete
gaps.evidence: Stable test IDs and controls exist, but a full focus, shortcut, contrast and assistive-technology matrix is not demonstrated.
gaps.acceptance: Keyboard-only, focus order, shortcut, contrast and screen-reader checks are all evidenced.

gaps.title: Compatibility layers and duplicate constants increase drift risk
gaps.evidence: Legacy, preview and current contracts coexist.
gaps.acceptance: Compatibility paths are minimized, versioned and covered by explicit migration tests.

gaps.title: Revision and clash scale proof is incomplete
gaps.evidence: Functions are implemented but current-head packaged proof on multiple representative large models is incomplete.
gaps.acceptance: HVPC and a second large regression model pass revision, deviation, broad-phase and exact selected-pair checks.

closure_order: Freeze one authority commit and release PR.
Close HVPC load, frame and input latency gaps without identity or color loss.
Make the Viewer model-dominant and implement full Qt plus VTK evidence capture.
Resolve hidden-line and BCF scope decisions.
Regenerate all functional and visual evidence on exact current HEAD.
Replace the hard-coded 51-check gate with dynamic 317-requirement acceptance.
Build and verify one-folder, portable and installer artifacts on clean Windows systems.
Publish only when no P0 or P1 gap remains.

functional: All feature matrix items PASS or formally approved OUT_OF_SCOPE.
No critical stub, placeholder or silent fallback.
Whole-object selection and cross-view synchronization remain stable after edit, reload and workspace changes.
correctness: Zero missing, duplicate, empty or box fallback objects.
Exact and proxy provenance always visible and exportable.
performance: First usable preferably at most 3.0 seconds.
Input-to-render p95 at most 35 ms and p99 at most 50 ms.
RSS drift below 10 percent after ten minutes.
visual_and_ux: Full Qt plus native VTK capture matches the user-visible window.
release: Evidence and artifacts identify one exact commit.
One-folder, portable, installer, associations, upgrade and uninstall pass.
No open P0 or P1 gaps.
